summary: Macerich Co filed a preliminary prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for a proposed public offering of 16,000,000 shares of common stock (with a 30-day underwriter option for an additional 2,400,000 shares). The shares are priced at the prevailing market price; on May 8, 2026, the last reported sale price was $21.87 per share. The registrant is the issuer. This is a routine equity offering (at-the-market), not a special situation category event. There is no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a standard capital-raising transaction. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; monitor for successful completion of the offering.
